$description: Setup wizard steps. Each field edits one config key; the web Setup tab and Claude's setup prompt both read this file.

steps.title: Connections
steps.intro: Where Rewdio finds REW and the miniDSP. Start REW with its API enabled (and REW Pro for sweeps), and run minidspd.

steps.title: Your miniDSP
steps.intro: The model sets the DSP sample rate, which the EQ maths depends on.

fields.label: Maximum output delay (ms)
fields.help: As shown in the miniDSP plugin's delay control

fields.label: Sub PEQ slots Rewdio may use
fields.help: Leave the others for your own filters

steps.title: Measurement mic
steps.intro: Your SoundID Reference calibration file (download it from Sonarworks by serial number).

fields.label: Calibration file
fields.help: Full path on the computer running REW

fields.label: Sensitivity (dBFS at 94 dB SPL)
fields.help: From the cal sheet; leave empty if unsure

steps.title: Speakers
steps.intro: Which miniDSP output feeds which speaker (outputs are numbered from 0).

steps.title: Timing
steps.intro: Loopback is best: a Y-splitter from your DAC's left output into the interface's input 2.

fields.label: Start delay (s)
fields.help: 2 for S/PDIF DACs that need to lock

fields.label: Keep the digital stream alive between sweeps

steps.title: Room and seats
steps.intro: Measured from the front-left floor corner: x = towards the back, y = to the right, z = up.

fields.label: Main seat x, y, ear height (m)
Mic positions to measure
fields.help: MLP first; add nearby spots for averaging

steps.title: Sub placement crawl
steps.intro: Put a sub at your seat and walk the mic around a lettered grid to find the best sub spots.

fields.label: A1 distance from the front wall (m)
A1 distance from the left wall (m)

steps.title: Sound
steps.intro: The crossover already set in your miniDSP, and how much bass lift you like.

fields.label: House curve file (optional, overrides the lift)
Allow PEQ as a last resort

steps.title: Phone remote
steps.intro: Lets a paired phone drive the crawl over your home Wi-Fi.

fields.label: Allow phone access on the home network
